why: B delivers a big wall of dark wood shelving with two 90 cm bookcases, which is what the client asked for (a large bookcase filling much of the left wall holding many books). A has only one 90 cm bookcase, so the wall is under-filled. B's classic floor lamp and light round rug are fine, but the shaggy rug is a slightly less natural-textile choice than A's jute. A's jute rug is the better material match, and its swing-arm lamp is better for reading. The bookcase requirement matters most, so B wins.
